title: His trumpets and cornets over the years
summary: He lists the Buescher, Conn and Martin horns he bought, lost or had stolen, and the five he owns now, including a King cornet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Well I think I've wrote kind of a horn in the years now. When did you change over the trumpet?

Oh when I changed over the trumpet, my first trumpet I bought was a busher. I bought that busher in 30. But I didn't like it because it was very keen and very, very long and not knowing better in those days. I didn't know that I wasn't getting, it didn't have, it didn't carry much volume.
